description: Data behind docs/progress.md (the development-progress dashboard). Update this file and run `python scripts/build_progress_page.py`; never edit docs/progress.md by hand.

framework.amendment: Amendment 20 (two-arm evidence charter for the covered-earnings correction design)
framework.next_ceremony: A4 evidence freeze, then the C20 ratification chain toward revision 22

foundations.text: The Dynamics paper: the full design, the benchmark comparison against DYNASIM, MINT, and CBOLT, and the evaluation plan.
The population-view scoring harness: geometry blocks, trajectory windows, and the moment battery that scores candidate models.
Label-verified PSID readers building the 1968–2022 head/spouse earnings panel, plus the demographic and earnings data modules around it.
A statutory Social Security benefit oracle (AIME/PIA) whose parameters load from PolicyEngine-US.
A locked, pre-registered evaluation contract: gate-1 thresholds are ratified and change only through public amendment plus a fresh referee round.
145 committed evidence artifacts — noise floors, gate runs, sensitivities — each pinned by reproduction tests.
The covered-earnings correction design itself, advanced through adversarial referee review to registry revision 21, with Amendment 20 in the ceremony pipeline.
A public timeline-forecast ledger: 22 registered entries, every revision with its reasons on the record.

arms.label: Prompt-purpose census
arms.description: Establishing what each of the ~21,000 remaining items in the PSID's 1968–2023 questionnaires and codebooks is actually asking, so the model only uses variables whose meaning has been adjudicated rather than assumed. Each block runs a full pass, an independent dense audit, and a correction sweep before its entries are adopted into the governing ledger.
arms.unit: prompts adopted (contiguous R1–R20815 — ARM COMPLETE, terminal fold v1.97)

arms.label: A3 classification arm
arms.description: Deciding how zeros and missing readings in the source data should be interpreted — a true zero, a question that was never asked, or an inapplicable route — across a 41,103-row queue of PSID variable readings, in 800-row blocks with 20% independent audits and correction sweeps.

arms.label: Q5 semantic annotation
arms.description: Verifying which survey questions connect to which data fields, document by document across the PSID questionnaire corpus: two independent annotators per document, then a reconciliation that seals its table of record.
arms.unit: documents sealed — 63 of the 81 annotated questionnaires (77.8%); the 257 denominator is the fixed PSID source-documentation domain: every survey instrument is annotated, and the other 176 are non-instrument files (setups, codebooks, raw data), 43 of them classed Semantic N/A by the coverage audit (not a law term)

milestones.name: Milestone A — revision-22 ratification (A20 framework operative)
milestones.note: Not gated by the Q5 program; requires the purpose census (3,230 ranks remaining at registration), the A4 evidence freeze and the C20 ceremony chain.

milestones.name: Milestone B — corrected-earnings successor authority and publication (the resolution event)
milestones.note: Gated by the Q5 program (45/257 documents, 20.2% of required atoms at registration; two document classes unstarted) and completion of the purpose census.

milestones.text: Evening: the Amendment 20 A4 freeze was re-frozen after its first candidate failed the pinned battery at the scratch state (a test the freeze itself extended validated the working-tree registry as production whenever ratification was flagged ready, so it could not hold at any scratch state). The re-frozen candidate C′ (820da19, sole parent 86e6994) differs from the first only in that test and its one capture row; the §34 semantic digest is unchanged and was reproduced with the parent commit's own projection code; the candidate battery passed 220/220 and the scratch-state battery is the remaining gate. Scratch transition S′: dispatched to Astra at 18:01 EDT after the re-freeze report showed readiness 31/31 and both batteries 220/220. Read-only review of the candidate's prose found that the freeze removed seven sentences from the parent (the three permitting sentences already known, plus a meaning clause, a blanket prohibition on authority selection before activation, and a rule that a proven residue controls) and added at least twelve law-shaped sentences with no parent counterpart, one of which rules on how the campaign's own board may be read; all reproduced from bytes by a second party and carried to the two closure referees as questions, not rulings. Kit round r8b installed under the two-engine gate: referees now run a whole-document sentence diff in both directions with stated splitter parameters, source-byte probes, and a guard that the withheld-ranks sentence belongs to the missing-reason arm's occurrence census, not the purpose ledger (which stays at 100.00%). Two figures in the decision package were corrected: the MEASURED-family population is 79 occurrence lines, not 78 (one bracket opens with an en dash that a same-line scan cannot see; four parties had run the same scan), and the tag-id unit is 126 under its author's own rule (122 numbered items by five independent methods plus four verified §4/§5 items), not 127. The errata's own 'largest unswept surface', a truncation ending mid-clause somewhere in the decision package's 185 quoted spans, was swept exhaustively: every span ruled (167 complete, 9 truncated at a boundary, 8 altered, 1 not locatable) and zero mid-clause truncations, with the population re-derived blind and all nine control loci recovered. Graph side: the Plan A shadow plan reached revision 11 through three peer gates and merged to master; its first build slice is running on a Claude lane (Opus) since 17:08 EDT with its first commit (7515f9b, the q5graph package and its test suite) at 17:52, on a Claude lane under the agreed resource policy with no escalation. Q5 stands at 63/257; the twelve decisions remain with Max.

The purpose census is COMPLETE: 20,815 of 20,815 prompts adopted (100.00%) at the terminal fold, ledger v1.97 (ebe3d2b9…). Blocks 7–10 of the final tranche folded through the day (v1.93–v1.97), every audit CALIBRATED; block 8 was folded in two parts after an orchestrator scope error (the brief was cut from the per-section table, leaving 64 ranks unadjudicated until an 8b completion pass) and block 9 closed the 2021 questionnaire entirely. A standing correction now requires every lane to recompute each digest it emits from the named file and run its own 64-hex self-check, after a 63-character digest was copied forward from a dispatch brief. A compile-only decision package (twelve decisions the package orders by how much work each blocks, against 63 sealed, 17 held and 1 withdrawn of the 81 annotated documents, although an errata compile finds that order does not consistently follow its own criterion) is staged for ruling; it lists five items it says the commissioning brief missed, the sharpest being that the worktree the lanes run in is two ratified design revisions behind master (19 vs 21), although the slot-catalog section the top decision turns on is byte-identical at both. Two figures already in front of the ruling were corrected: the atomisation coverage gap is 331 of 447 enumerated Social Security, pension, annuity and retirement items in no atom (74.05%, not the 72.7% the census printed and its replication reproduced without recomputing), and the corpus's page and frame digests are reproducible under the pinned Poppler pdftotext 26.04.0, which the design, the inventory code and the stage-1 replay artifact all name and the code enforces (cross-host determinism untested) (a Chronicle cross-check with pypdf 6.11.0 reproduced 0 of 101 pages, the pinned recipe 101 of 101); the final-tranche pass reports did not restate the build until the block-10 audit did. Q5 stands at 63/257, which is 77.8% of the 81 annotated questionnaires; the remaining 176 files in the fixed domain are setups, codebooks and raw data, not instruments. The open questions are recorded for ruling; the compiler ruled on none of them.

Overnight the purpose census reaches 94.88% (final-tranche block 6 folded as ledger v1.92, the fourth consecutive CALIBRATED audit and the first to carry a correction), and the sixteen-document 1968–1982 family back-catalogue is fully annotated and reconciled: six documents sealed, one seal withdrawn on adversarial review, nine held pending rulings (Q5 63/257, which is 77.8% of the 81 annotated questionnaires — the 257 denominator is the fixed source-documentation domain, 43 of which can never seal; a counter reconciliation confirmed the figure across three instruments). A compile-only dossier found the design fixes seven sentinel identifiers (four job-slot, three component-slot) in a section outside every span the briefs had pinned, overturning the campaign's three-sentinel reading and its bar on the seventh literal; a supersession audit reduced whether the tier-1 minting bar is in force to a single unresolved sentence about Amendment 13's recording act; and a full-corpus atomisation census, replicated by an independent method, found that 331 of 447 enumerated questionnaire items naming Social Security, pensions, annuities or retirement lie in no atom of the sealed evidence base (66 of 81 documents). Materialization closed with 83 tables of record on disk and exactly two documents provably unrecoverable. All open questions are recorded for ruling, not resolved locally.

Final-tranche blocks 4 and 5 close (ledger v1.91; purpose reaches 93.13%), both dense audits CALIBRATED at 100% on full 273-row replays; 1,431 ranks remain across blocks 6–10. Q5 seals q2009, fam2013, q2019 and fam1968 (58/257); fam1968 is the first of a sixteen-document back-catalogue of 1968–1982 family volumes found never briefed and now opened. Five reconciled documents are held and q2023 stays unsealed on the campaign's first 'Q5 status does not pass' verdict, pending five law rulings raised for decision rather than resolved locally: the identifier-minting remedy under §26.5.1, two evidence-integrity classes (digest-only and corrupt sealed payloads), the H-object scope of the pinned law extract, and a minting-clause precondition naming a field that nine artifacts lack. A prepare-only materialization sweep of all 69 reconcile reports writes every reproducible table of record to disk as a first-class artifact with provenance marked decoded or reconstructed (64 tables at last count), and recovery runs prove two of the three corrupt payloads (1995q, 1994f) reproducible from surviving emissions.

Final-tranche blocks 1–3 close (ledger v1.89; purpose reaches 90.50%): block 1 on its regeneration sweep, block 2 CALIBRATED at 99.66% on a one-row manifest, block 3 CALIBRATED at 100% with an empty contradiction set. Q5 seals 2003q, 2005f, 2005q, 2007f, 2007q and 2009f (54/257), the last five on Opus reconciliations; the first Opus/Opus pairs measure common-mode rates of 0.4%, 1.8%, 0.0% and 2.9%. The C20 ceremony-kit correction reaches its fifth round as a Sol-written change that an independent Opus review ACCEPTS, clearing the last precondition on the A4 evidence freeze other than the census itself. Six Claude accounts run Opus lanes in parallel after subfleet's false month-long parks are found and cleared.

The E5 first tranche completes: block 8 closes on its audit's closed 16-row manifest (ledger v1.84; purpose reaches 85.94%). The final tranche R17889–R20815 is planned as the entire remainder — 2,927 ranks across eight documents from 2013 to 2023 in ten blocks (v1.85) — and its first block passes 348/348 and is audited (v1.86) with a 59-row regeneration manifest. Q5 seals 2001f, 2003f and 2001q (48/257), the latter two on Claude Opus reconciliations in 42–43 minutes against a one-to-three-hour Sol baseline.

E5 blocks 6–7 close (ledger v1.83; purpose reaches 84.48%) and the tranche's last block, block 8 to R17888, is in flight. Q5 seals 1999f and 1999q — the latter the campaign's largest table of record at 8,498 rows — reaching 45/257. An output-order mandate (full serialization first, no placeholders) is adopted as standing process law for large deliverables after a truncated sweep had to be re-run.

E5 blocks 3–5 close (block 3 CALIBRATED at 100% — the third perfect purpose block); purpose reaches 81.78%. Q5 seals 1997q after a dual-serialization cross-recovery repaired a damaged lane print without a re-run (43/257).
Purpose census enters the E5 era (2003–2011 questionnaires; tranche R15625–R17888 pinned) and reaches 77.53% overnight; Q5 seals 1996q and 1997f (42/257).

The A3 classification arm COMPLETES: all 41,103 queue rows final-adopted (49,722 adjudicated ranks across the A1/A2/A3 programs, zero predicate defects campaign-wide). Purpose census reaches 71.00% with its last in-scope document (q2001) in the verification cycle; Q5 reaches 38/257.

Evening sprint: purpose reaches 60.97% (blocks 5–7 closed; q94–q95 complete; the q96 opener — E4’s final document — enters audit); A3 reaches 93.4% with its first two audit-clean blocks ever; Q5 seals 1992q (34/257) under a new occurrence-local binding-law ruling.

Purpose census reaches 55.61% (q94 B+C closed under ledger v1.44 after the audit reversed the opener’s imported simultaneity frame — the cross-document transfer prohibition holding under pressure); A3 frontier reaches 35,200/41,103 (85.6%).

E3 questionnaire era completed and the E4 era opened overnight; f94 complete; purpose census reaches 54.10% contiguous. A3 reaches the 1968-era queue boundary (83.7%). Q5 seals documents 048–049 (33/257).
Purpose census crosses 50% of the residual domain (contiguous R1–R10457 = 50.24%); q93 B+C complete.
f91 complete; purpose census at 43.11% contiguous; governing ledger reaches v1.26.
f89-era tranche closed: contiguous R1–R8552 = 41.09%; every rank of the 1,920-rank tranche went through pass, dense audit, adjudication where audits split, and correction sweep.
Timeline-forecast entry 21 registered: scope bifurcation into milestones A and B.
